name: Chloe
source: Chloe is a musician in the fairy tale "The Musician and The Puppeteer". She is an excellent violinist, her dream is to let everyone hear her beautiful piano sound, so she finds a puppeter to help her realize her dream. Later after death, Chloe turned into a puppet responsible for playing the violin in the opera house. She was given eternal life by The Puppeteer and became the guardian of the theater.
